research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free review of shared mathematical prerequisites with original context and non-merge restrictions.

aliases.reason: The functor-of-points source's Hom_Sch(T,X) is the hom-collection of morphisms with fixed source and target in the locally small category of schemes. It is an instance of Hom_C(A,B) under C=Sch; contravariance and pullback by precomposition remain source-specific.

The bounded-operator norm source takes sup of the set {||Tx||:||x||≤1}; the Dedekind completeness source defines least upper bound sup(A) in an ordered set. The operator-norm supremum is a special bounded nonempty real-set instance, not a distinct supremum predicate.

The covariant representability source invokes F:C→Sets, an ordinary covariant functor into the category of sets, which is an instance of the generic functor F:C→D. Its set-valuedness and any local-smallness convention remain parent-specific; generic functorial identity/composition laws are the shared prerequisite.

Local module descent uses a finite principal Zariski cover Spec(R)=⋃_iD(f_i); locally free modules use an arbitrary family of standard opens covering Spec(R). The cover-by-principal-opens construction is shared; source's finite index restriction, unit-ideal generator equivalence and gluing conditions stay parent-specific.
